sentences.text:
Interim Application No. 840 Of 2024
 In
 Criminal Appeal No. 225 Of 2024
 Ramraj Paltu Vishwakarma ..
 Versus
 The State of Maharashtra and Anr. ..
 Mr. M. Fernandes i/b Advocate C. S. Patil, for the Applicant.
 Ms. Kranti T. Hivrale, App, for the Respondent-State.

Coram: Suman Shyam &
 Shyam C. Chandak, Jj.

.  Learned Counsel appearing for the applicant/appellant has pointed out that the conviction of the appellant in this Case is under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code ('IPC') and, therefore, the matter will have to be heard after due service of notice upon the victim.

However, in this case,
despite service of notice upon the victim/respondent No.2, none has appeared on her behalf.
2. Ms. Kranti Hivrale, learned APP, submits that the notice sent through Investigating Officer of the concerned Police Station could not be served as the officer could not trace out the victim.

sentences.text: Be that as it may, since service upon the respondent No.2 through postal mode is already complete and none has filed Vakalatnama on her behalf, we direct that a legal-aid Advocate be appointed so as to represent her interest in the matter.

4. Registry to furnish the requisite papers to the learned legal- aid Advocate so appointed.
5.
List the matter again on 29th August, 2025.

(SHYAM C. CHANDAK, J.) (SUMAN SHYAM, J.) { 6th August 2025 Ramraj Paltu Vishwakarma vs State Of Maharashtra on 6 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146662584/
